text:
sam: Booking for awk situation need quick guidance before i push the button. 5 Qs: 1) partner joining but paying their own way can i book a shared room and have the company reimburse my half? 2) child care at home for two overnights eligible? 3) passport expedite fee reimbursable? 4) hotel invoice shows VAT and a weird tourist fee how do i submit? 5) lost a $22 tram receipt will finance accept?

liz (People Ops): Short answers: 1) yes if partner pays their share. Book the room, submit only your prorated portion and attach proof (partner payment screenshot or note). Manager pre-approval recommended. 2) childcare is eligible only for overnight business trips when regular childcare isnt available need manager sign-off and receipts. 3) passport expedite reimbursable with manager pre-approval and proof of business travel dates. 4) upload original invoice; finance handles VAT reclaim when invoice is in company name. If in your name we reimburse gross. 5) for <$25 missing receipts we accept card statement + missing-receipt affidavit in Expensify.

sam: for #1 the booking confirmation only lists one name. is a note enough?

liz (People Ops): Note is OK but stronger to get partner payment proof (screenshot of transfer or email) or manager confirm. Add: "partner paid 50% - name + amount" in expense notes.

sam: child care  my regular nanny charged extra for two nights. what docs?
josh (Finance): We need provider invoice with dates, amount, provider contact, and manager approval in notes. We dont reimburse family members. Maximums follow policy caps; attach the manager approval.

anna (Travel Ops): Passport expedite: if travel is within 2 weeks, request pre-approval via travel-ops form. If you already paid, tag the expense "passport-expedite - manager pending" and DM your manager.

sam: VAT/tourist fee  can you reclaim VAT if invoice in my name?
josh (Finance): No reclaim if invoice in your personal name. We reimburse gross. If invoice shows company VAT number we can attempt reclaim; attach invoice and booking confirmation. Reclaims can take months. We will note any reclaimed VAT against the expense record later.

sam: lost $22 tram receipt  i have cc charge and a photo of the station ticket machine. acceptable?
josh (Finance): Acceptable for <$25: include card statement line + short note + missing-receipt affidavit from Expensify. For anything larger we'll ask for more.

sam: one more  conference provides dinner on day 2  if i pick per-diem do i still mark that meal?
liz (People Ops): Yes mark the provided dinner when selecting per-diem; system deducts that meal portion. Alternatively claim actuals with receipts.

sam: sample note i should drop in the expense?
josh (Finance): Paste this into expense notes:
```
Trip: Barcelona partner visit - 2026-05-11
Room: shared with partner (partner paid 50% - transfer screenshot attached).
Childcare: overnight nanny 2026-05-11 to 2026-05-12 - invoice attached. Manager approval: Jordan (Slack DM).
Passport expedite: 60 USD - travel within 10 days - manager pre-approved (email attached).
Hotel invoice: 240 EUR (includes 21% VAT + 3 EUR tourism fee) - invoice attached. Invoice in employee name - reimburse gross.
Missing tram receipt: 22 EUR - card transaction attached + missing-receipt affidavit.
```

people-ops-bot: Policy: https://redwoodintranet.company/travel-policy See sections: "Shared-room bookings", "Childcare during travel", "Passport & Visa fees", "EU VAT", "Missing receipts".

sam: excellent. i'll get manager sign-off and upload docs. thanks! :thumbsup:
